say:1:1910547001:1.text: Everyone ready? Get on the Waterstrider. Let's head out!
say:1:1910547001:1.source_cn: 都准备好了吧？上水行器来，咱载你们出发！

narration:2:1910547002:1.text: Tolan starts the Waterstrider and carries you all out through Coralia's barrier.
narration:2:1910547002:1.male: Tolan starts the Waterstrider and carries you all out through Coralia's barrier.
narration:2:1910547002:1.female: Tolan starts the Waterstrider and carries you all out through Coralia's barrier.

narration:3:1910547003:1.text: 潮光在保护魔法光壁四周翻涌，水行器不断加速、在加速，径直向更深的黑暗冲去……

narration:4:1910547004:1.text: It's time to find this mysterious Graveborn and discover the source of the glowing tide.
narration:4:1910547004:1.male: It's time to find this mysterious Graveborn and discover the source of the glowing tide.
narration:4:1910547004:1.female: It's time to find this mysterious Graveborn and discover the source of the glowing tide.
